limitations: This approval does not authorize a PHASE-03 implementation write before a valid pre-change capture binds this decision, the approved scope-lock hash, the current hashes of the allowlist modified paths, and the current worktree state.
After the pre-change capture is verified, writes remain limited to the allowlist paths and the declared directory root in the approved scope lock.
The shared parser scripts/lib/audit-governance-schema-v3.ts and the phase 4 scripts (prepare-audit.ts, pre-check-evidence.ts, validate-audit.ts) are not writable under this approval.
